anchor.notes: Homeowner 2025 ANCHOR benefit. Final eligibility depends on principal-residence and program rules.

senior_freeze.calculation: Eligible reimbursement is generally the increase above the established eligible base-year property tax, subject to complete continuous eligibility and program review.

stay_nj.notes: FY2027 annualized maximums for the 2025 application. State guidance says qualifying taxpayers receive benefits totaling half their property-tax bill up to the income-tier cap; final program allocation is determined by the Division of Taxation.

global_cap.rule: Total property-tax relief benefits cannot exceed property taxes paid on the principal residence for the same year.
